title: Milk Chocolate Ice Cream (No Egg)
changes_from_base: Melted milk chocolate replaces the strawberries, with less added sugar to balance its sweetness.
summary: Smooth, gentle and nostalgic: a pale-brown milk chocolate ice cream with less added sugar, so the chocolate leads.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Warm the milk
steps.text: Heat the milk, sugar, syrup and salt in the saucepan until steaming and the sugar has dissolved. The sugar is low because milk chocolate brings plenty.

steps.title: Melt in
steps.text: Pour the hot milk over the chopped milk chocolate in the heatproof bowl, leave for 1 min, then whisk to a smooth, pale-brown liquid.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Whisk in the cold cream and vanilla, then chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 20-30 min, until thick and creamy like soft serve.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Scrape into the container, cover the surface and freeze for at least 4 h before scooping.

tips: Use a good-quality milk chocolate with at least 30% cocoa solids.
If the chocolate does not fully melt, warm the bowl over simmering water for a moment.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10 min in the fridge before scooping.
